rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for getting used to a new situation, environment, or condition.
Use this in everyday speech when changing something into a form suitable for a new purpose.

example.english: We can adapt this table into a desk.
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 toi2 ho2 ji5 goi2 zou6 syu1 toi2

rows.note: Use this specifically when adapting a story, book, or other creative work into another version or medium.

example.english: After people adapt this novel into a TV drama, it becomes very popular.
example.traditional: 呢套小說改編成電視劇之後好受歡迎。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 siu2 syut3 goi2 pin1 sing4 din6 si6 kek6 zi1 hau6 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4
